content.text: A lighthouse keeper climbed the spiral stairs every night for forty years, and never once did he tell his wife that the light he tended had guided him home from the sea the night she was born. On his final evening, as the great lens turned for the last time, a small boat drifted toward the rocks, and he found himself hoping someone aboard was watching the light the way he always had.
